question: Lalrinpuii is the Health & Family Welfare Minister of which of the following states as of October 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lalrinpuii** serves as the **Health & Family Welfare Minister** of the state of Mizoram as of **October 2024**.
 
• **Mizoram** is one of the northeastern states of India, bordered by **Tripura, Assam, and Manipur**, and also shares international borders with **Bangladesh and Myanmar.**
